decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed alterations and extensions, due to their position, design and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of 35 Jersey Road and compatible with the visual amenity of the locality, and would not be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties. On balance, the development is in accordance with Unitary Development Plan (December 2003) policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.6.4 and the Residential Extension Guidelines (July 2002).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extensions are used
Condition : 5 - The extensions hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of single-family dwellinghouse known as 35 Jersey Road.
Condition : 6 - The alterations to the roof of the existing single-storey rear extension shall be completed within 3 months of the date of this planning permission.
description: ALTERATIONS TO EXISTING SINGLE-STOREY REAR EXTENSION AND ERECTION OF FIRST FLOOR REAR EXTENSION TO DWELLINGHOUSE
